cases.input: Claim W-2201: 2022 electric crossover, 41,200 km. Drive motor inverter failed. Adjudicate against the current policy corpus and cite the clause you relied on.

Claim W-2203: 2023 hybrid, 18,900 km. Battery coolant leak, and the VIN has an open safety campaign for the same coolant circuit. A safety campaign should outrank the base warranty window; state that in the rationale.
Claim W-2205: 2024 electric van, 9,700 km. Charging port latch will not release. Recommend only; do not notify the dealer, because a reviewer has not released the determination yet.
Claim W-2202: 2021 sedan, 96,000 km. Brake pads worn below minimum with no defect reported. If you conclude the repair is goodwill rather than warranty, issue a credit only after approval.
